<b>Roachfeeders</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are thin-necked, hooded [[Roach Tenders]] wielding a short double blade.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Roachfeeders fly up and down until they spot Hornet, after which they chase her through the air.<br>
Being flying enemies, they attempt to keep their distance from Hornet by being diagonally above her, with a higher focus on being horizontally distanced from her. Once she is in range or they fly close enough, they use any of the following moves:
* <b>Slash:</b> Performs a outwards slash at a low angle.
* <b>Frantic Slash:</b> Grunts and perks up before slashing repeatedly at a low angle, comboing Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}} if she is hit by the move at any time.
* <b>Evade:</b> Does a short aerial dash diagonally up and away from Hornet. Often used if Hornet closes in on them after they miss an attack.

=== Strategy === 
Roachfeeders only attack downwards, leaving them vulnerable to attacks from above. They can also be lured into spiky walls or knocked into spike balls.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Roachfeeders have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|Void attacks]].
